request.style: English, gentle acoustic singer-songwriter, soft female vocal, fingerpicked guitar, light piano, glockenspiel, airy and calm, 82 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I lie awake and count the bills, I count the hours till day
I write the lists of all I need and the lists of what I'll say
Then in the morning on the step a sparrow comes to sing
He doesn't know where lunch will come from, he isn't worrying

[Chorus]
Look at the birds of the air
They do not sow or reap or gather into barns
And yet your heavenly Father feeds them
Are you not worth far more than they

[Verse]
Consider how the lilies of the field grow
They do not labor or spin
Yet not even Solomon in all his splendor
Was dressed like one of these

[Chorus]
Look at the birds of the air
They do not sow or reap or gather into barns
And yet your heavenly Father feeds them
Are you not worth far more than they

[Bridge]
But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness
And all these things will be given to you as well
So do not worry about tomorrow
For tomorrow will worry about itself

[Outro]
Your heavenly Father knows that you need them all
Your heavenly Father knows
